finding: finding-lint and dispatch_lib.py each parse the section Possible damage with their own rules, and the two already disagree. finding-lint accepts `* ` bullets, dispatch_lib.py reads only `- ` bullets. Reproduced with a critical finding that uses `* ` bullets: finding-lint reports no damage violation, and the stop notice prints an empty possible damage list. Fix: let one function own the parse. dispatch_lib.py is the place for it if finding-lint may import a sibling module, as it already does for _main_checkout.
why_this_severity: mdformat turns `* ` bullets into `- ` bullets, and every finding is formatted before commit, so a committed finding prints its items (no to fails_purpose). The rule exists twice, so a later change of the section format must find and change both parsers.
